data.description:
The timeseries data to be plotted in the chart. This will be directly used as a ECharts dataset.
The shape is the following:
```
{
  "source": [[timestamp, value1, value2, ...], ...]
  "dimensions": ["timestamp", "value1", "value2", ...]
}
```

unitMap.description: A map of dimension to unit. This is used to determine the units of each dimension in `data`.

labelMap.description: A map of dimension to label. This is used to determine the labels of each dimension in `data`.

title: Represents the timeseries data to be plotted in a {@link UiApTimeseriesChart}.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartTsDataset
